notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/relative permeability.md
notes.title: relative permeability
notes.excerpt: The ratio of a material’s permeability to the permeability of free space , indicating how much better it conducts magnetic flux than air or vacuum.

notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/reluctance.md
notes.title: reluctance
notes.excerpt: Opposition to the flow of magnetic flux in a material, analogous to electrical resistance in circuits.

notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/rescheduled.md
notes.title: rescheduled
notes.excerpt: Refers to the revised allocation of generation or load after a disturbance, outage, or constraint to maintain system balance and security.

notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/shield wires.md
notes.title: shield wires

notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/snubber circuits.md

notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/substations.md

notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/switched waveform.md

notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/switched-mode power supply.md

notes.path: Resources/Dictionary/synchroscope.md
